messages:
leah: Heads up — we need an access-scope review for the PCI customer integration. Prefer a 30–45m sync next Tue or Thu. Proposed agenda: 1) scope recap, 2) access matrix walkthrough, 3) identified gaps, 4) mitigation + owners. Who needs to be there?

arjun: I can do Tue afternoon (PST). Add me for RBAC/arch notes. @marta do you have the latest access matrix export?

marta: I have a WIP export. Will push it to Drive today. Can we make it 45m? need time to walk nested roles and service accounts.

leah: 45m works. Also want to include sec reviewers — @dan @tia — could one of you take compliance sign-off?

dan: I can do Thu morning (PDT) or Tue after 4pm. If Tue I may only be able to join the first 30m. I'll review the compliance checklist before the meeting.

tia: Thu morning works better for me. If most are on Tue I can do Tue 9:30am PDT as a fallback. Also pls add these as pre-reads: access_matrix.xlsx and threat_notes.md

sec-bot: Reminder: attach docs to the thread or sharing will fail for vendor accounts. Use `/grant` to share with external reviewers before the meeting.

leah: Plan: I'll poll for Tue 4:00pm PDT vs Thu 10:00am PDT. Draft agenda (will post in thread): facilitator: leah; matrix walkthrough: marta; RBAC changes: arjun; compliance checklist: dan; threat model sign-off: tia. Tell me if I'm missing an owner.

arjun: :thumbsup: also add a quick rollback/canary step for any role changes to the agenda.

marta: Uploaded export: drive.redwood.com/r/access_matrix_1955.xlsx — shared with this group.

leah: Quick question: are we okay sharing the matrix with vendor SREs during the meeting? need explicit opt-in before I include them.

dan: Fine from compliance as long as we redact any PII and user identifiers. Approve sharing with that caveat.

tia: Agreed — redact account IDs. I'll prepare a small redaction script and attach before the meeting.

leah: Great — I'll run the poll now and post the calendar invite once we have consensus. If you have other items for the agenda, drop them in this thread.
